content: Google Code Wiki (codewiki.google, 2025-11): auto-generates living repo documentation (architecture, modules, classes, diagrams, API refs) from Gemini; re-checks code after each change and rewrites docs + regenerates diagrams; direct links docs->source; Gemini chat over wiki as KB. Read-only 'generate + browse', no human review/comment loop, no native-language projection. Validates auto-code-wiki lane is giant-occupied; PrismDocs should not compete there.
